name: Famous Deep-Fried Monte Cristo Sandwich (Grease/Sugar Warning)
whyItWorks: Layers of ham, turkey, and swiss cheese dipped in thick batter, deep-fried in boiling oil, dusted with powdered sugar, and served with seed-heavy blackberry jam. The enormous fat concentration triggers massive bile dumping and acute diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Fat Warning: Avoid during Crohn's flares. If in remission, take 1-2 small bites and share the remainder, avoiding the berry seeds.
